title: Four-Cylinder Engine Assembly
description: Kinematic 4-cylinder engine assembly featuring crankshaft, connecting rods, and pistons modeled in SolidWorks.
fullDescription: A comprehensive mechanical assembly of a 4-cylinder internal combustion engine designed in SolidWorks. Includes articulated crankshaft geometry with counterweights, precision connecting rods, wrist pins, and pistons designed with accurate mechanical clearances for dynamic kinematics simulation.

title: Deep Groove Ball Bearing
description: Precision industrial deep groove ball bearing assembly with inner ring, outer ring, balls, and retainer cage.
fullDescription: Engineered in SolidWorks for high-speed radial loads. Features standardized boundary dimensions, raceway groove radii, contact angle optimization, and a brass/polymer ball separator cage.

title: Industrial Roller Chain Sprocket
description: Heavy-duty power transmission roller chain drive sprocket with ANSI/ISO tooth profile and keyed shaft hub.
fullDescription: Precision power transmission sprocket designed with standard ANSI/ISO roller chain tooth profiles, weight-reduction relief pockets, and a keyed shaft hub for torque transfer in mechanical drive trains.

title: 90° Flanged Pipe Elbow
description: High-pressure ASME-standard 90-degree flanged pipe elbow with raised gasket face and 8-bolt flange patterns.
fullDescription: ASME B16.5 compliant industrial piping fitting designed for fluid and gas transport systems. Features uniform wall thickness throughout the sweep radius, standard bolt circles, and raised sealing faces.

title: 4-Way Cross / X-Pipe Fitting
description: Precision 4-way intersecting pipe cross manifold fitting engineered for hydraulic and exhaust systems.
fullDescription: Multidirectional fluid distribution fitting modeled in SolidWorks. Features internal blend radii designed to minimize turbulence and maintain pressure equilibrium across intersecting fluid lines.

title: Industrial Pedestal Mount
description: Heavy-duty cast pedestal bearing mount with foundation mounting slots and structural reinforcement ribs.
fullDescription: Rigid casting pillow block pedestal mount designed to support rotating shaft bearings under dynamic vibration and high loads. Features slotted base bolt holes for alignment adjustment and lubrication fittings.

title: Sheet Metal Louver Forming Tool
description: Custom SolidWorks sheet metal punch and die library feature for stamping ventilation louvers.
fullDescription: Specialized sheet metal forming tool modeled with cutting lip and progressive emboss geometry to punch ventilation louvers into sheet enclosures without material shearing or tearing.

title: Ergonomic Desktop Tape Dispenser
description: Consumer product design featuring an ergonomic weighted base, core-cavity parting lines, and tape roll spindle.
fullDescription: A complete consumer product development model designed for plastic injection molding. Features balanced wall thickness, draft angles, snap-in tape spool, and an integrated serrated cutting blade.

title: Smart LED Light Bulb Housing
description: Consumer electronics enclosure with aluminum heatsink cooling fins, polycarbonate diffuser dome, and E27 base.
fullDescription: Thermal-optimized IoT light bulb housing modeled in SolidWorks. Features radial thermal management fins, snap-fit optical diffuser, flame-retardant driver housing, and standard threaded lamp base.

title: Slotted Hollow Cylinder
description: Precision-machined tubular sleeve with alternating axial expansion slots for collet clamping applications.
fullDescription: Precision CNC-machined cylindrical component featuring alternating radial expansion slots. Engineered for uniform clamping force distribution and flexible pneumatic/hydraulic sleeve applications.

title: Parametric Spiral Staircase
description: Architectural helical staircase designed around a central structural column with cantilevered steps.
fullDescription: A mathematically defined helical staircase designed in SolidWorks. Features parametric tread rise-and-run spacing complying with structural standards, continuous outer handrail sweep, and modular assembly.

title: Interlocked Möbius Rings
description: Complex geometric topological sculpture demonstrating advanced 3D curve surfacing and continuous tangency.
fullDescription: Advanced surface modeling project in SolidWorks demonstrating complex 3D sketches, projected guide curves, and swept curvature continuity (G2) for an interconnected non-orientable Möbius strip system.

title: Apple 3D Emblem
description: Precision geometric 3D emblem modeling demonstrating Golden Ratio arc profiles and drafted beveled chamfers.
fullDescription: A clean 3D CAD modeling exercise in SolidWorks focusing on tangency control, golden ratio arc fillets, precision sketch constraints, and brushed metallic edge beveling.

title: Heavy-Duty Hydraulic Cylinder
description: Industrial high-pressure hydraulic cylinder actuator with piston rod, barrel, and clevis mounting.
fullDescription: Heavy-duty industrial hydraulic actuator designed in SolidWorks for fluid power systems. Features honed cylinder barrel, hard-chrome piston rod, seal packaging, and clevis mounting ears for heavy machinery applications.
